headline: The TYPO3 Action API
headline_accent: A typed API for the backend, integrations and AI agents.
lead: An action is a typed PHP method that the TYPO3 backend, external applications and AI agents can call. TYPO3 validates input and output, documents the action and checks access; no controller is needed.

channels.title: AI agents
channels.text: MCP tools, over HTTP or stdio

facts.title: One implementation
facts.text: One PHP method serves the backend, integrations and AI agents.

facts.title: Typed and validated
facts.text: JSON Schema derived from PHP types; input and output are checked.

facts.title: Runs as the user
facts.text: Backend permissions apply; scopes limit what an app may do.

facts.title: MCP built in
facts.text: A built-in MCP server offers every action as a tool.
